name: Hamehameha
source:
The Demon King that reigns over the Maygard Continent.
The very culprit that screwed the Hero's party in the Demon Castle.

Cold, calculative, and condescending towards human life, she has no reservations about killing. In addition, she wields powerful magic thanks to her massive magical power.
